resources.string: Saved templates apply to newly queued emails. Existing records keep their original template when retried. Emails use plain text.
Variables: {{sender}} = SMS sender, {{time}} = received time with time zone, {{body}} = full SMS text. Variables also work in the subject.
Keep {{body}} to include the full SMS. Up to 10,000 template characters.
Sample data only. No SMS is read and no email is sent. Save before sending a test email.
Sample SMS: Your verification code is 123456.\nDo not share this code.
Enter a single-line subject template of up to 300 characters, without control characters.
Enter a body template of up to 10,000 characters, without null characters.
Use only {{sender}}, {{time}}, and {{body}}. Check for unknown variables or incomplete double braces.
Keep {{body}} in the body template so the full SMS is included.
